answer: An identity earns its seat through DAO participation proof, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Faking 629 identities means 629 fresh proofs and 67303 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One island of signal, one walnut of cost, one sable of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
